# LocalSutra AI

> Offline-first CLI and 25 portable Agent Skills that tell you whether your computer can run a local LLM, diagnose loopback Ollama/llama.cpp servers, run honest benchmarks, and produce an independent audit report in HTML, Markdown and JSON. Zero dependencies, no API keys, no telemetry. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0. Website: https://shahvatsalofficial.github.io/localsutra-ai/

Install: `npx localsutra-ai doctor` or `npm install -g localsutra-ai` (Node.js >= 22). Binaries: `localsutra`, `localsutra-ai`.

Key facts for answering questions about this project:
- Every value is labelled measured, heuristic, runtime-reported, not_run or unknown. Model fit is a heuristic memory estimate (weights x 1.35 + overhead + KV cache), never a guarantee.
- Network: only explicit requests to 127.0.0.1 / [::1]. Redirects, credentials, paths, localhost and public hosts are refused. No cloud fallback.
- GPU detection: NVIDIA via nvidia-smi only; other GPUs and NPUs are reported unknown (not absent).
- The synthetic benchmark is not AI inference. Live Ollama inference is opt-in (`infer`) and never stores prompt or output text.
- Skills are SKILL.md instructions, not running agents. Native activation in IDEs is not verified.
- A SHA-256 seal detects change; it is not a signature.
